rationale: Create one canonical Montreal Gateway Terminals Partnership company. Axium's live portfolio identifies Montreal Gateway Terminals as an operational transportation-infrastructure investment, while current company and Port of Montreal pages confirm that the business operates the Cast and Racine marine container terminals as one platform and that Termont Montreal is a separate operator. The Axium-led consortium completed its 100% acquisition from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners on March 5, 2015. The disclosed Axium vehicle was Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P.; Axium's individual percentage was not disclosed. Morgan Stanley's official release establishes its former 2007-2015 ownership through MGT Holdings S.a.r.l. Public sources last named Desjardins, Manulife, Fonds de solidarité FTQ and Industrial Alliance as acquisition consortium members, but no sufficiently current direct evidence was found to carry them forward as active 2026 owner rows. A 2025 refinancing identified FA MGT Limited Partnership as the parent but did not constitute an equity transfer. No later sale, secondary, concession termination, bankruptcy or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026.

aliases: Terminaux Montréal Gateway Société en commandite
afterImage.description: Montreal Gateway Terminals Partnership is a common-user marine container terminal operator at the Port of Montreal. It operates the Cast and Racine terminals as one intermodal platform, providing vessel, yard, reefer, storage, gate and rail/truck-transfer services to global shipping lines and cargo owners serving Canada and the U.S. Midwest and Northeast. The Port of Montreal reports effective handling capacity of 800,000 TEU at Cast and 500,000 TEU at Racine. A consortium led by Fiera Axium Infrastructure acquired 100% of the business from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners on March 5, 2015; Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. was the disclosed Axium vehicle, but Axium's individual stake was not published. Axium's live portfolio continues to list the asset as operational. A 2025 debt refinancing identified FA MGT Limited Partnership as the parent but did not transfer equity. Public evidence reviewed did not support carrying the other 2015 consortium members forward as confirmed active owner rows, and no later sale or signed pending exit was found through August 18, 2026. Termont Montreal, the Port authority, and the individual Cast and Racine terminals are not separate companies within this record.
